definitions.explanation: A legal punishment imposed for a crime.

examples.japanese: {裁判所|さいばんしょ}は{被告人|ひこくにん}に{懲役|ちょうえき}5{年|ねん}の{刑|けい}を{言|い}い{渡|わた}した。
examples.english: The court sentenced the defendant to 5 years in prison.

notes:
{刑|けい} refers to legal punishment.

TYPES OF PUNISHMENT:
- {死|し}{刑|けい} (death penalty)
- {懲役|ちょうえき}{刑|けい} (imprisonment)
- {禁固|きんこ}{刑|けい} (imprisonment without labor)
- {罰金|ばっきん}{刑|けい} (fine)
- {実|じっ}{刑|けい} (actual prison sentence)
- {執行|しっこう}{猶予|ゆうよ} (suspended sentence)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {刑|けい}を{受|う}ける (receive a sentence)
- {刑|けい}を{言|い}い{渡|わた}す (hand down a sentence)
- {刑|けい}に{服|ふく}する (serve a sentence)
